rules.title: Berkeley tenant screening fee rights statement and fee-cap disclosure
rules.requirement: Owners who charge a fee for a credit report and application processing must give applicants, in the application or a separate disclosure before taking the fee, a clear Tenant Screening Fee Rights Statement and a statement of the maximum fee cap under Civil Code 1950.6(b).
rules.quoted_span: the owner must provide, either in the rental application or in a separate disclosure before receiving the fee, a clear and conspicuous tenant screening fee rights statement and a statement of the maximum fee cap permitted under
rules.key_value: Disclosure of fee rights and max cap before collecting fee

rules.title: Berkeley ban on non-refundable fees for existing tenancies
rules.requirement: Landlords cannot charge existing tenants a non-refundable fee to renew a tenancy, including fees tied to a roommate leaving or being added or replaced.
rules.quoted_span: cannot charge a non-refundable fee to any existing tenant for the purpose of renewing a tenancy, in whole or in part, including any fee associated with the departure of a roommate or to request to add or replace a roommate in a pre-existing household.

rules.title: California tenant screening fee cap and rules (as described by Berkeley Rent Board)
rules.requirement: Screening fees are capped (2026 maximum $68.96). Landlords must give a receipt, itemized costs, a copy of the credit report and a refund of unused fees, must not charge when no unit is available, and must use a reusable screening report if provided.
rules.quoted_span: The maximum tenant screening fee for 2026 is
rules.conflict_note: The span is from a Berkeley page; the $68.96 figure for 2026 is as stated there and no single official statewide figure is confirmed.

parsed.doc_summary: Berkeley Rent Board page on tenant screening and application fees: state cap under Civ. Code 1950.6 ($68.96 for 2026), Berkeley fee-rights disclosure (BMC 13.78.010), and a ban on non-refundable fees for existing tenants (BMC 13.78.016).
